lines: Join now asks the ride hub for your seat, and a full or started session sends you to the next one.
Press Join, and the ride connects to the hub and takes a seat in that session, with a jersey colour of its own.
With ten riders seated, the hub says the session is full, and Class Start offers the one fifteen minutes later.
Arrive after the start, and the hub turns you away. Class Start shows the next session instead.
If the link drops, the ride asks again as soon as it is back, and keeps the same seat.
The group ride looks the same on every screen, with your seat held underneath.
What the tests prove: a seat until the start, ten at most, the next session offered, and the same seat again.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
